commons.title: 20160126 Sri Lanka 3926 Dambana sRGB (25143078323).jpg
commons.description:
Our visit to the Veddahs, Sri Lankan aboriginal people, starts with an audience with Chief Uruwarige Wannila Aththo.  In the corner are large bottles of traditional medicines (the chief is also a medicine man) and small bottles of wild-bee honey.
The Veddahs (Hunters) are thought to have arrived in Sri Lanka 18,000 years ago.  Today there are about 2,500 Veddahs.  They no longer hunt for food as that is prohibited by the government.  We see just a handful of Veddahs, all men.
On Google Earth:

Veddah village  7°24'39.56"N, 81° 6'54.42"E
commons.editorial_reason: Veddah chief is shown in traditional dress with attributed traditional medicines and honey.

commons.title: 20160126 Sri Lanka 3978+93+4+6+7 Dambana sRGB (25139204554).jpg
commons.description:
Lunch is catered out in the woods by Eco Team, Sri Lanka.  We start with brown onion soup followed by a selection of salads/appetizers such as beets, dal [lentils], green beans, gourd, and fried lake fish along with rice.  The main course is grilled chicken and pork served with a barbecue sauce.  Dessert is curd with coconut-palm treacle.
